::: {#xp-guide-compulsory-courses}
:::

::: {.contribution authors="kai-wu"}

The University offers a range of courses for PhD students. They are announced on Learning Mall ([link](https://core.xjtlu.edu.cn/course/view.php?id=847)) and in emails titled *Updates on Workshops for Postgraduate Research Students*. You can choose most courses according to your own needs and level, but two are compulsory: you cannot graduate without attending them. They are:

- Supervisor-Supervisee Relationships

- Research Integrity (Ethics)

Both workshops run every **semester**. You must attend each one at least once before graduating; attendance is determined by scanning the sign-in QR code at the event.

(7 October 2022, by [Kai Wu](mailto:kaiwu.astro@gmail.com))

:::
